text: Pooja and Dev got engaged last weekend in Lisbon! The wedding will probably be sometime next summer. Remind me to send them a card the week after they get back.
Haruto's housewarming is Saturday at 7pm. He said not to bring anything, but he mentioned his new place has no decent wine glasses.

Divya called this morning. Her parents' 40th anniversary is at the end of the month and she's organising a surprise dinner for them. She sounded quite stressed about it. Her brother Anil was meant to help but he's away with work until the 25th, so it's all on her. She's booked a private room at the Italian place on the high street for the Saturday at 7. I should offer to help with decorations the day before.
Need to buy a present for Anil and Meera's wedding. The list closes early March, so sooner rather than later.
Andile mentioned his sister Imani is moving to Leeds sometime next week. She's starting a new job there on the 3rd.
Graham's retirement do has been cancelled because his wife is in hospital. I should ring him tomorrow evening and see how they're both doing.
Lola is vegan now, apparently since the summer. Worth remembering for the dinner party.
Picked up the suit from the tailor. Still need to get shoes before Matteo's wedding on the 14th.
Ibrahim Costa from accounts invited me to his engagement party on Friday at 8. His fiancée is called Fatima and she works at the hospital.
Lucy said she and Rory have been married ten years on Thursday. They're going to Rome for a long weekend.

Beatriz is hosting a dinner for her book club the night after next. She's really nervous about cooking for twelve people. Last time her oven broke halfway through and she ended up ordering takeaway. She's planning a paella, which she's never made before. I said I'd come over early that afternoon to help prep. Need to take my big pan round tomorrow morning.

Chat with Damian over lunch. He's thinking of proposing to Tamar over the summer, probably on holiday in Greece. Hasn't bought a ring yet. He asked me to come ring shopping with him sometime next week, maybe Wednesday after work. Tamar apparently prefers vintage things and hates anything too flashy, so he's thinking of looking at antique shops rather than the big jewellers. Her best friend Imani might know her ring size.
Remind me to text Salma good luck the day before her best-woman speech. The wedding is the 21st at half 2.
Julia's dog Biscuit had his operation yesterday afternoon. She said he's sleepy but okay. Check in with her at the weekend.
Suzanne and Heather are throwing a joint 30th in early December. Venue still not decided. Heather keeps hinting that she'd love a pasta maker.

Duc rang. His brother Luis got married in Hanoi last month and he's just back. Showed me the photos; it looked incredible. Luis and his wife are coming over to visit at the end of the month and Duc wants to throw them a little reception here, since most of his friends couldn't make the trip. Probably the Saturday evening at his flat.
Tanvi's leaving drinks are next Thursday from 6. I'm going straight from work so I'll miss the start.
Mrs Nakamura next door invited us to her granddaughter's christening on Sunday at 11. Hiroshi will be there too.
Don't forget to order flowers for Ann's anniversary. Twenty-five years on the 9th. Get them delivered that morning.
Caroline is engaged! Her partner Fang asked on her birthday. They're thinking of a small ceremony sometime in spring.
Saanvi said her cousin's wedding is three days long and she's dreading the travel. Flying out on the 2nd, back on the 6th.
Booked the restaurant for our anniversary. Saturday at 8, table by the window.
Pooja's mum is turning 70 at the end of the month. Pooja wants to do a garden party but the weather might ruin it.
Haruto said the housewarming went well, though the neighbours complained about the noise. I should drop round with the dish he left at mine sometime next week.
Anil told me Meera's grandmother passed away over the weekend. The funeral is Wednesday morning. They're thinking of postponing the wedding.
Divya's surprise dinner for her parents went really well. Her dad cried apparently. Message her tomorrow to say well done.
Andile is learning salsa for his wedding first dance. He and his fiancée have lessons every Tuesday evening until June.
Got invited to Graham's 60th. It's a barbecue at his allotment on the 18th at midday. Need to RSVP by Friday.
Ibrahim asked if I could be an usher at the wedding. Of course I said yes. Fittings are sometime in early March.
Lola and her boyfriend Matteo broke up. The engagement party next month is off. She's staying with her sister for now.
Lucy's in-laws are visiting for their anniversary. She's hosting Sunday lunch and is worried the house isn't big enough.
Remember to pick up the card for Beatriz on the way home tonight.
Damian's parents are renewing their vows in Portugal over the summer. He asked if I'd film it. Must check whether I'm free in the first week of August.
Tamar's work Christmas party is the 12th at half 7 and she has nobody to go with. Offered to be her plus one.
Imani said the move is done and her flat is lovely, but she feels a bit lonely in a new city. Call her this weekend.
Salma's speech went brilliantly yesterday. Everyone was in tears. She's off on her honeymoon to Bali tomorrow morning.
Julia's a big gardener, mostly roses and dahlias. She's also into pottery classes on Mondays.
Suzanne mentioned she's been offered a job in Manchester, starting sometime in the new year. Not sure if Heather will move with her.
Need to sort the spare room before Mum and Dad come to stay. They arrive Friday afternoon.
Duc and his wife Tanvi are celebrating their first anniversary on the 28th. He wants to recreate their first date and asked me for restaurant ideas. Remind me to send him the list that evening.

Ann said her son is getting married in Cape Town in early March. She's terrified of flying but doesn't want to miss it. Her daughter Julia is going with her, which helps. They fly out on the 28th of February at 6am. Remind me to ring Ann the night before to wish her a safe trip, and to ask how the wedding went once she's home.
Hiroshi Nakamura is coeliac, so the dinner on Saturday needs a gluten-free option.

Long chat with Caroline after the gym. Fang's parents are flying over from Shanghai for the engagement dinner on the 19th, and she's never met them before. She's anxious about the language barrier and wants to learn a few phrases in Mandarin before then. Fang has been really supportive. The dinner is at a place in Soho at 7. I should text her good luck that afternoon and ask how it went the day after.
Saanvi got back from the wedding. Exhausted but happy.
Rory's band is playing at Pooja and Dev's engagement party. First gig in two years. Saturday at 9.
Weekly shop, bank, and return the parcel before the post office shuts at 5.
Meera's sister Tanvi is pregnant, due sometime in April. Meera's going to be an auntie for the first time and can't stop smiling.
Matteo Rossi invited everyone to his parents' restaurant for their 30th anniversary. Saturday the 25th at 7. Smart dress. Bring cash for the collection.
Fatima's hen do is the weekend of the 8th in Brighton. I need to pay the deposit by the end of the month and remind Lucy about it too.
Heather loves anything Studio Ghibli. Good to know for Christmas.
Remind me to call Uncle Graham the week after his anniversary to see how the cruise was. They sail on the 4th and are back on the 15th.
Fang mentioned his mother's 80th is over the summer and the whole family is flying in. He's planning a banquet.
Anil and Meera have rescheduled the wedding to early June. Same venue. New invitations are coming sometime next week.

Dev is struggling a bit with wedding planning. Pooja's family want a huge do and his want something small. He said the arguments are getting to him. Ask him for a pint on Thursday after work. He also mentioned his job has been hectic since the restructure and he barely sleeps. Pooja doesn't know how bad it's got. They've still not agreed on a venue and the deposit is due at the end of the month.
Lucy's daughter starts nursery on Monday morning. Lucy is more nervous than the kid.
Tanvi's leaving drinks were fun. She starts at the new firm on the 2nd. Don't forget to message her that morning.
Beatriz Schmidt and her husband are hosting a Halloween party on the 31st at 8. Costumes required. Their cat Pumpkin will apparently be dressed as a bat.

Divya asked me to be a witness at her registry office wedding. It's at 10am on a Friday sometime in early March. Very small, just the two families and a couple of friends. She said her fiancé Andile is happy with it but his mum is upset there won't be a big reception. I should help her find somewhere nice for lunch afterwards.

Ibrahim said the engagement party was a bit of a disaster. The caterers didn't turn up and Fatima's dad had to order pizza for sixty people. They laughed about it in the end. Fatima's grandmother gave a speech in Arabic that nobody else understood but everyone clapped anyway. The wedding is set for over the summer, probably late July, and they're looking at venues in the Lake District. Ibrahim wants a ceilidh.

Haruto is getting married! Proper ceremony in Kyoto next autumn, with a party back here for everyone who can't travel. He wants me on the playlist. Ask him for the date of the UK party once they've booked it, and remind me to book time off as soon as I know. Probably sometime in October.
